name: blast-charge-sequence-visual
description: Visual verification of charge loading UI and detonation sequence: explosive selection, amount, stemming, tubing, auto/manual sequencing, and delay patterns

steps.command: drill_plan grid rows:2 cols:3 spacing:4 depth:6 start:15,15
steps.description: The grid tool's spacing stepper defaults to 3m (DEFAULT_SPACING_M, Drill.ts); one increment click on the strip's spacing stepper (data-field="spacing") raises it to 4 before dragging, so the (15,15)-(23,19) rectangle (8x4) computes the declared 3 cols x 2 rows instead of the default-spacing 4x2 (issue #479 follow-up, Finding #4).

Per-hole charging is a real control now (gap G3, ChargeHoleList.ts): the Charge step renders a "Per Hole" section, one row per hole keyed by data-hole, each with its own commit button at [data-hole="<id>"] [data-action="charge-hole"]. That button dispatches `charge hole:<id> explosive:<selected> amount:<amount>kg stemming:<stemming>m` from the panel's current product card / amount / stemming values (ChargeStep.chargeHole, Charge.ts) — the same three values Charge All reads, so the steppers have to be driven to the declared numbers first. The explicit [data-step="2"] click is required: Charge All above completed the plan, so the still-armed autoAdvance had already moved the panel to Sequence. 3 amount increments (5 -> 8kg) and 5 stemming increments (2.0 -> 3.0m) reach the declared values. Amount steps by 1kg (data-field="amount", clamped to the selected product's [minChargeKg, maxChargeKg]); stemming steps by 0.2m with a 0.5m floor (data-field="stemming", Charge.ts adjustStemming). Both are plain instance fields on ChargeStep with no reset path, so they carry over from the previous charge step in the same page session — asserted before each commit rather than assumed.

expect.note: count is unchanged — Charge All had charged all 6; this proves one row overrides one hole

steps.description: The [data-step="3"] click is new and load-bearing: the per-hole charge step above disarms autoAdvance by clicking a tab, so the panel no longer walks itself to Sequence. delay_step:25 is the panel's own DEFAULT_DELAY_STEP_MS, so no delay-step stepper click is needed.

Per-hole delay is a relative +/- stepper ([data-hole="<id>"] [data-action="delay-inc"/"delay-dec"], Sequence.ts), stepping by the panel's current delay-step value and clamping at 0. Reaching an exact target is therefore arithmetic on the delay Auto Sequence actually assigned, read out of a real command-mode trace (screenshots/scenario-<name>-command/step-NN-sequence.json's sequenceDelays) rather than computed by re-deriving autoVPattern. Auto Sequence left H1 at 25ms with a 25ms step (traced: step-04-sequence.json), so a single decrement lands exactly on the declared 0.
H2 is Auto Sequence's row-1 lead hole, left at 0ms (traced: step-04-sequence.json), so 2 increments at the 25ms step reach the declared 50.
